notes: Elliptical אִם־לֹא: the negative is the clause's whole predicate and takes the supplied 'it be ... so' (rule 20); the alternative marking 'it be' and 'so' added is named in the unit.
לְאַל → 'nothing worth' fused and headed on the negative (rule 30); Hiphil כָּזַב → 'prove a liar' headed on the complement (rule 44).
